name: External HTTP access
description: EXT-USR browses APP-SRV on HTTP/80 through R1-EDGE and FW1, which publishes that service.

presentation.objective: Show a permitted inbound flow through the perimeter.
presentation.security_rule: FW1 OUTSIDE-IN rule 30 permits tcp to 10.0.30.10 port 80 (stateful: the reply is allowed back).
presentation.explanation: The packet crosses R1-EDGE and FW1, which permits published HTTP and tracks the connection, then CORE-SW1 and IPS-1, and APP-SRV answers. The firewall counters rise.
expected: The session crosses R1-EDGE and FW1 and is delivered to APP-SRV
FW1 OUTSIDE-IN:30 is hit and the reply is allowed by connection tracking
